audience.label: Who
audience.title: Who is it for?
audience.hint: Gather people from wherever you like. Anyone on more than one list receives it only once.

message.label: What to say
message.title: What do you want to say?
message.hint: Write the way you would write to a customer. The preview shows how it will arrive.

schedule.label: When
schedule.title: When should it go out?
schedule.hint: Messages go out little by little, so it doesn't look like a mass send. Nothing goes out outside the days and hours below.

review.label: Review
review.title: All good?
review.hint: Check what is going to happen. Nothing goes out until you confirm.

save.locked: This campaign is no longer a draft
save.exited: Draft saved. Continue whenever you like, under Campaigns.
save.leaveTitle: Leave without saving the last change?
save.leaveHint: We couldn't save right now. The rest of the draft stays saved.

discard.title: Discard this draft?
discard.hint: The campaign and its list of people are gone for good. No message was sent.

locked.scheduledHint: To change anything, cancel the schedule and create another one from it.
locked.launchedTitle: This campaign has already been launched
locked.launchedHint: Once launched it no longer changes. Follow the sends from here.

notFound.title: We couldn't find this campaign
notFound.hint: It may have been discarded. See the ones you have under Campaigns.

errors.nameRequired: Give it a name so you can find this campaign later
errors.connectorRequired: Choose at least one number to send from
errors.phoneRequired: Choose at least one number from the official account
errors.mediaRequired: Choose the file that goes along
errors.templateParamRequired: Fill in every blank of the chosen templates
errors.schedulePast: Choose a time that hasn't passed yet
errors.intervalRange: The longer wait must be equal to or longer than the shorter one
errors.intervalFloor: The shortest wait is 1 minute: anything less raises the risk of the number being blocked
errors.dailyLimit: The daily limit must be a whole number, 1 or more
errors.windowRange: The end must come after the start. To send all day, turn on the option above

audience.addFirst: Where do the people come from?
audience.mixHint: You can mix sources: the same person never gets in twice, even with the number written differently.

removeHint.contacts: Removes the people who came from your contacts. You can add them again later.
removeHint.imported: Removes the people who came from files and searches. You can add them again later.

audience.variablesFound: From your list, you can use in the message: {{list}}.

contacts.title: My contacts
contacts.description: People who already talk to you. Pick one by one, or filter by tag.

file.title: File
file.description: A spreadsheet in CSV, TSV, TXT or JSON, with name and phone.

sheets.title: Google Sheets
sheets.description: A spreadsheet from your Google account, nothing to download.

places.title: Businesses
places.description: Businesses by type and city, with the phone listed on Google Maps.

recipients.title: Who will receive it
recipients.description: Look someone up or remove anyone who shouldn't be here.
recipients.removeOneHint: This person won't receive the campaign. You can add them again later.
recipients.removeAllHint_one: {{formatted}} person leaves the list. You can build it again.
recipients.removeAllHint_other: {{formatted}} people leave the list. You can build it again.

contacts.title: My contacts
contacts.description: Check who gets in. Only people with a phone appear here: Instagram, Messenger and the website chat don't receive campaigns.
contacts.allHint: Applies to everyone matching the search and filters, even on other pages.
contacts.addedSkipped_one: {{formatted}} was already there or has no phone.
contacts.addedSkipped_other: {{formatted}} were already there or have no phone.
contacts.allThere_one: That contact was already on the list
contacts.allThere_other: Those contacts were already on the list
contacts.addFailed: Could not add them. Try again.
contacts.tooMany: That's too many at once. The limit is {{max}} at a time: filter a bit more.
contacts.discardHint: The checked contacts won't join the list.
contacts.empty: You don't have contacts with a phone yet
contacts.emptyHint: They show up here when someone talks to you on WhatsApp. Meanwhile, import a file.
contacts.noChannelsHint: Contacts come from a WhatsApp channel's conversations. Meanwhile, import a file.
contacts.noPermissionTitle: Your account has no access to contacts
contacts.noPermissionHint: Ask whoever manages the account, or import the list from a file.

mapping.name: Name column
mapping.same: Name and phone must be different columns.
mapping.countryCodeHint: A number needs the country code to get there. Those that already have it, or start with +, stay as they are.

reasons.invalidPhone_one: {{count}} with a phone that isn't a number
reasons.invalidPhone_other: {{count}} with a phone that isn't a number

mapping.variables: The other columns become message variables: {{list}}.

import.title: Import a file
import.description: Choose the file. It's read right here in your browser, and nothing uploads before you check it.
import.hint: CSV, TSV, TXT or JSON, up to 200 MB
import.stopped: Stopped at {{sent}} of {{total}}. Those already sent stay on the list.
import.keepOpen: Nobody receives anything now: this only builds the list. Keep this window open until it finishes. If the connection drops, just continue, and nobody gets in twice.
import.failedHint: Check your connection and continue where it stopped.
import.stopHint: The {{sent}} already sent stay on the list.
import.discardHint: Nobody from this file has joined the list yet.
import.doneDetail: {{skipped}} were already on the list and {{invalid}} came without a phone.
import.helpColumns: One column with the name and another with the phone, with the headers on the first line.
import.helpVariables: The other columns become variables: a Coupon column becomes {{token}} in the message.
import.helpPrivate: Anyone without a name or phone stays out, and the screen tells you who.
import.done_zero: Nobody new: these people were already on the list

sheets.title: Import from Google Sheets
sheets.description: Sign in to your Google account and choose the spreadsheet. The first line holds the headers.
sheets.downloadFailed: Could not download the spreadsheet. Try again.
sheets.privacy: You sign in with your own account, and access only covers this spreadsheet: it isn't stored.
sheets.unavailableTitle: Google Sheets hasn't been set up yet
sheets.unavailableHint: This account still needs to be connected to Google. Whoever manages the platform does it once. Meanwhile, in Google Sheets, use File, Download, Comma-separated values, and import the file here.
sheets.unavailableAdmin: For administrators: {{variables}} must be set on the server.

errors.scriptFailed: Could not reach Google. Check your connection and try again.
errors.loginFailed: Google didn't confirm the sign-in. Try again.
errors.pickerFailed: Google's spreadsheet picker didn't open. Try again.
errors.tabsFailed: Could not read this spreadsheet's tabs.

places.title: Businesses
places.description: Find businesses on Google Maps, or use the ones you already found.
places.searchHint: Results bring phone, address, website and social media, when they exist.
places.runningHint: It usually takes a few minutes. You can close this window: the result stays under Already found.
places.searchFailed: The search didn't work. Try again.
places.noResultsFound: Nothing found. Try another word or place.
places.filterResults: Filter by name, address or category
places.searchExisting: Search by name, address, phone or category
places.noneYet: You haven't searched for any business yet
places.noneYetHint: What you find stays here, to use in other campaigns.
places.selectAllPage_one: Select {{formatted}} with a phone on this page
places.selectAllPage_other: Select the {{formatted}} with a phone on this page
places.phoneOnly: Only those with a phone get in
places.dataKept: The data stays on the conversation
places.discardHint: The checked businesses won't join the list.
places.unavailableTitle: The search hasn't been set up yet
places.unavailableHint: This account still needs to be connected to the service that finds businesses. Whoever manages the platform does it once. What was already found remains available.
places.unavailableAdmin: For administrators: {{variable}} must be set on the server.

channel.title: Where it goes out from

text.title: Free message
text.description: Write whatever you want, with a photo, video or file. It goes out through the connected WhatsApp.

template.title: Approved template
template.description: Texts approved by Meta, through the official account. It's the only way to reach people who haven't talked to you in over 24 hours.

channel.manyHint: With more than one number, messages are split between them and sending goes faster.
channel.numbersHint: Check the numbers of the official account. With more than one, messages are split between them.
channel.noNumbers: This official account has no number available yet.
channel.noneHint: Connect a WhatsApp to be able to send. Your draft stays saved meanwhile.
channel.noneHintMember: Ask whoever manages the account to connect a WhatsApp. Your draft stays saved meanwhile.

message.caption: Caption
message.placeholder: Hi, {{token}}! The new collection is in and I set something aside for you.
message.variationPlaceholder: Another way of saying the same thing
message.captionPlaceholder: Optional. Write what goes along with the file
message.variablesHint: To call each person by name, use the buttons right below the box, or type / and choose.
message.variationHint: With more than one version, each person receives one of them, taking turns. That way messages aren't all the same, which helps protect the number.
message.variableMissing: {{token}} doesn't exist on your list, and the person would read {{token}} as written.
message.variablePartial: {{token}} only exists for {{count}} of {{total}} people. The others would read {{token}} as written.

media.hint: Photo, video, PDF, spreadsheet or document, up to 100 MB
media.libraryHint: Photos, videos and documents you've already sent.
media.libraryEmpty: You haven't sent any file yet
media.noCaption: Documents go without a caption: WhatsApp only shows the file.
media.unsupported: This kind of file can't be sent in a campaign. Choose a photo, video or document.

template.search: Search by name, category or text
template.noneHint: Templates are texts Meta approves before you can use them. Approval usually takes a few hours.
template.waiting_one: {{count}} template not yet approved is off the list.
template.waiting_other: {{count}} templates not yet approved are off the list.
template.notUsable: This template asks for data in the header or a button, and campaigns only fill in the body text.
template.fill: What goes in the blanks of {{name}}
template.fixedOrVariable: A fixed text or a variable
template.rotationHint: With more than one template, each person receives one of them, taking turns.

preview.title: How it will arrive
preview.emptyTemplate: Choose a template to see how it will arrive

reply.title: And when they reply?
reply.flowHint: Anyone replying to the campaign goes straight into this flow. Without a flow, whatever already works in your conversations applies.
reply.noFlowsYet: You don't have published flows yet.
reply.tagsHint: Every conversation reached gets these tags, so you can find it later.
reply.raise: Move the conversation up the list on each send
reply.raiseHint: When off, the conversation goes to the end of the list and your team isn't interrupted by the send.

schedule.nowHint: Starts right away, within the days and hours below.
schedule.laterHint: It stays scheduled, and starts by itself on time.
schedule.allDayHint: No start or end time. Includes the small hours.
schedule.paceDetail: One every {{range}}. Up to {{perDay}} a day, per number.
schedule.paceHint: The faster it goes, the higher the risk of WhatsApp blocking the number. If in doubt, stay with balanced.
schedule.interval: Time between one message and the next
schedule.intervalHint: Each wait is drawn between these two times: a pace that's too regular looks like a robot.
schedule.dailyLimitHint: It adds up all of that number's campaigns. On reaching the limit, it waits for the next day.
schedule.volumeWarning: That's a lot of people. Large volumes can block the number: start slowly and watch the sends.

estimate.title: What should happen
estimate.noAudience: Add who will receive it to see the forecast.
estimate.waits: Outside sending hours. The first one goes out on {{date}}

review.name: Campaign name
review.nameHint: Only you see it: it's how it shows up on the list. Recipients don't see this name.
review.fixFirst: There's something to sort out before launching
review.disconnected: {{names}} is disconnected and stays out. Those it would send to go through the other numbers.
review.rotation: Each person receives one of them, taking turns.
review.scheduledWaits: Scheduled for {{date}}, outside the sending days and hours. The first one goes out on {{first}}
review.startsNow: Starts as soon as you launch
review.pace: One message every {{range}}, up to {{limit}} a day on each number.
review.finishesSoon: Should finish in less than an hour.
review.costText: Nothing per message here on the platform.
review.costTemplate: Nothing here on the platform. Meta charges for conversations started with a template, directly on your company's account.
review.safety: After launching, you follow the sends and can pause whenever you like. What already went out doesn't come back.

confirm.launchHint: Messages start going out through your number. You can pause whenever you like, but what already went out doesn't come back.
confirm.scheduleHint_one: {{formatted}} person starts receiving it on {{date}}. Until then, you can cancel.
confirm.scheduleHint_other: {{formatted}} people start receiving it on {{date}}. Until then, you can cancel.
confirm.variables: Heads up: {{tokens}} won't be replaced for everyone, and whoever receives it will read it as written.
